_doc: Where Ashita and Windower 5 word an entity field differently: the pairs judged to name the same thing (spelling or detail only), and those that say different things, to be measured (docs/MEASURE.md). A judgement of the coordinating session from the two names, not a fact; a measurement replaces it.

different: measure.0x24: Ashita: the last position; Windower: the position (current)
different: measure.0xE8: Ashita: the next entity (a link); Windower: the owner
different: measure.0x11C: Ashita: an action timer; Windower: a freeze flag
different: measure.0x204: Ashita: model size; Windower: model scale (and 0x208: hitbox size vs model size): the two may be swapped
different: measure.0x208: Ashita: model hitbox size; Windower: model size
different: measure.0x20C: Ashita: environment area id; Windower: Monstrosity flags
different: measure.0x210: Ashita: Monstrosity flag; Windower: Monstrosity name
different: measure.0x2A2: Ashita: warp target index; Windower: owner index
